_about: Transcription providers, hand-kept from the docs. Keys: none = MeetStream supplies it; dashboard = the user's own key under Integrations > Transcription.
post_call: MeetStream's own engine (adds a per-hour charge; see the pricing page). The only post-call provider that needs no key everywhere.
Shown as Interfaze; the API key stays jigsawstack
Not for bots in the US region (code)
create_bot only (not POST /transcribe): the platform's own captions; Google Meet (English, live) and Teams (after the call); Zoom only on bots that join without the customer's app
rules: Streaming-only providers make no post-call transcript and send no transcription.processed (get_transcript returns 202 indefinitely: cap polling); bot.done still fires.
Re-run a post-call transcript with POST /api/v1/bots/{bot_id}/transcribe; each run gets a new transcript_id.
POST /bots/{bot_id}/transcribe needs a provider: there is no server default (400 without one) (code).
No API lists providers; this list is kept from the docs and the code.
